subject: Fiscal entity onboarding — legal name, address, and PO remittance contacts
messages:
From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa.romero@mosaic-sys.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding: Mosaic Systems — initial docs

Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro. I work on finance ops at Mosaic Systems — we need to be added to Redwood's vendor/payee registry so you can issue POs and remit payments. To get started I've attached our basic documents.

Quick summary of what I'm sending:
- Mosaic_W9_2027.pdf — signed W-9 (EIN on file)
- Mosaic_BoD_certificate.pdf — board resolution confirming legal name and address
- Mosaic_bank_details.xlsx — bank routing + remittance preferences (ACH and wire tabs)

Can you confirm which fields you require to complete the vendor master? Also, do you need a separate remittance contact/email for PO routing vs invoicing? If possible, we'd like POs to go to procurement@mosiac-sys.com (cc finance@) and invoices to be routed to ap@mosiac-sys.com.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Alyssa Romero
Finance Operations
Mosaic Systems, Inc.
Attachment: Mosaic_W9_2027.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Mosaic_BoD_certificate.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Mosaic_bank_details.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: Mosaic Systems — initial docs

Hi Alyssa — thanks for sending these. We received the attachments and can begin the vendor master setup. A few clarifying items before I submit the record to procurement: 

1) Legal name confirmation: the board resolution shows "Mosaic Systems, Inc." — that will be the legal entity name used for tax and contracts. Please confirm there are no DBAs we should capture.
2) Primary business address: can you confirm the street address listed in the BoD cert is the remit address you want on our vendor record? If you use a different remit address for invoices, note that separately.
3) Tax classification: W-9 indicates C-Corp — confirm that remains correct for 2027.
4) Remittance & PO contacts: please confirm the specific emails for PO routing, AP invoice receipt, and a technical contact for purchase questions. We prefer separate addresses for each function to avoid delays.

To make this fast, please reply with a one-line confirmation for items 1–4 and attach a copy of the remit address proof if it's different from the BoD certificate. Once I have that we will:
- Create the payee record in our ERP (expected completion 2 business days)
- Assign PO routing rules (which email will receive automated PO notifications)
- Configure ACH/wire details behind our payment controls (finance will require bank-verification steps)

Copying Karthik from procurement for PO routing specifics and Marissa from legal for contract name verification.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

--
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Neha — thanks, quick confirmations below (copied exactly so you can paste into the vendor form):

1) Legal name: Mosaic Systems, Inc. (no DBAs)
2) Business / remit address: 1248 Harbor Blvd, Suite 300, San Mateo, CA 94401 — this is our remit address and should be used on the vendor record.
3) Tax classification: C-Corp — EIN 12-3456789 (shown on W-9)
4) Contacts (please use these):
   - PO routing: procurement@mosiac-sys.com (Procurement inbox)
   - Invoice receipt (AP): ap@mosiac-sys.com
   - Remittance confirmation (finance contact): finance-ops@mosaic-sys.com / +1 650-555-1222 (Alyssa Romero)
   - Technical/fulfillment: vendor-ops@mosaic-sys.com

Note on bank file: the bank details sheet includes both ACH and wire. We prefer ACH for standard payments; wire only for international/expedited. If Redwood requires micro-deposits for verification, let us know and we can authorize.

Also attaching the signed BoD certificate again for ease.

Best,
Alyssa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa.romero@mosaic-sys.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: Mosaic Systems — initial docs

Hi Alyssa — appreciate the quick responses and the attachments. I set up a draft vendor record in our ERP and have the following next steps to close onboarding: 

- Neha will open the payee in the system with legal name and remit address you confirmed.
- Finance will initiate ACH micro-deposit verification using the bank details file; expect an email from payments@redwood.com asking you to confirm the micro-amounts.
- PO routing: procurement@mosiac-sys.com will be added as the PO inbox. Automated POs will be sent from pos@redwood.com; please whitelist that domain.
- Contracting/legal: Marissa will confirm the contract name on a quick check and follow up if she finds a mismatch.

One procedural note: we require a completed vendor questionnaire for high-dollar vendors. Given Mosaic's annual expected spend, please complete the short form here: https://redwood.app/forms/vendor-risk-questionnaire (you can use the same sign-in as the onboarding packet). It takes under 10 minutes.

Once micro-deposits are confirmed and the questionnaire is completed we will mark the vendor active and POs can be routed. Targeting closure by EOD next week.

Thanks again — looping payments and legal as needed.

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

--
